arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Edge case: Empty braces
try:
    parse.Parser('{}')
    print('Empty braces OK:', parse.Parser('{}').parse('hello'))
except Exception as e:
    print('Empty braces error:', type(e).__name__, str(e))

# Edge case: Just a single brace  
try:
    parse.Parser('{')
    print('ERROR: Single opening brace should fail')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Single opening brace correctly rejected')

try:
    parse.Parser('}')
    print('ERROR: Single closing brace should fail')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Single closing brace correctly rejected')

# Edge case: Multiple escaped braces
p = parse.Parser('{{{{double}}}} {name}')
print('Multiple escaped:', p.parse('{{double} hello'))
" 2>&1 | tail -10
